# go-tgz

> Pack files, directories and streams into timestamped .tar.gz / .zip archives.
> Go library; tar.gz via archive/tar + compress/gzip, zip + WinZip AES-256 via github.com/alexmullins/zip.
> Import: github.com/afeiship/go-tgz (package tgz)

## API

- tgz.Archive(sources []string, opts ...Option) (*Result, error) — validate sources, build timestamped filename, create output dir, write tar.gz (or .zip via WithFormat). sources[0] == "-" packs the WithReader stream as a single "stdin" entry (base name falls back to "bk"). Never prints.
- tgz.Filename(base, pre, tsLayout, suf string, t time.Time) string — "[{pre}_]{base}_{ts}[_{suf}].tar.gz"; invalid layout passes through verbatim.
- tgz.Format / FormatTarGz / FormatZip — archive container selector
- tgz.WithFormat(Format) — default FormatTarGz; FormatZip writes .zip
- tgz.WithPassword(string) — WinZip AES-256 password; empty = no encryption; errors with "password requires zip format" when format is tar.gz; only regular-file data encrypted, filenames stay visible

## Options

- WithPrefix(string) — tag before basename
- WithSuffix(string) — tag after timestamp
- WithDir(string) — output dir, default ".", auto-created; ignored when WithWriter is set
- WithTimestamp(string) — Go time layout, default "20060102-150405"
- WithWriter(io.Writer) — stream mode, no file written, Result.Path == ""; takes precedence over WithDir
- WithReader(io.Reader) — data source for "-"
- WithTime(time.Time) — fixed timestamp, default time.Now()

## Result

- Name string — archive filename
- Path string — full path, empty in stream mode

## Errors

- "no sources given"
- "reader is required for source \"-\""
- "stdin mode takes a single source \"-\""
- "source not found: <path>" (other IO errors wrap the cause with %w)
- "password requires zip format"

## Behavior notes

- Validate-all-then-pack; failed packs remove the partial archive — no half-written archives on disk.
- Dirs: recursive, entries relative to the dir itself, prefixed with the directory's name (e.g. demo/a.txt), empty dirs kept, symlinks stored not followed.
- Checked writer closes: a failed gzip flush surfaces as an error, never a silent truncated success.
- Zip output uses github.com/alexmullins/zip (fork of archive/zip with WinZip AE-2). Plain zip interoperates with stdlib archive/zip, bsdtar, Python zipfile; encrypted zip needs macOS Archive Utility / 7-Zip / WinZip (Info-ZIP unzip cannot decrypt AES). Dir and symlink entries are NOT encrypted — encrypting them breaks libarchive extraction.
- Go directive is 1.26.0; golang.org/x/crypto v0.58.0 pinned indirect.

## Tests

go test __tests__/*.go -v
